title: Recruit fallback rates and Gold Robber backgrounds
summary: The hero recruit table gains fallback rates for six more pools, and two new Gold Robber event background textures are registered. No Palmon, skill or item data changed.
highlights: Hero recruit: no-hero fallback rate of 500 added for pools 1016, 1019, 1020, 2016, 2019 and 2020.
New background textures goldrobberbg and goldrobberbg9 registered.
